balls.text: really fast .. RP swings and misses and the ball goes past the leg stump and the keeper lunges to his left to stop it .. they rush across for teh run.
full and outside off, keeper collects .. RP is just being mute witness here

Finally, some one takes Rohit's catch! It was the bouncer outside off, Rohit top edges it towards short third-man region and Lumb runs back from backward point to take it. Very valuable innings from Rohit, though. It has given Deccan a total they can try to defend. Hope floats.
moves outside leg, Tait pushes it further outside off, around 147 kmph, the batsman let it go to the keeper but rohit calls over for a single
low full toss outside off, dragged to midwicket region
moves outside leg and cuts to deep-point region
Whack. Overpitched on the middle and leg line, Rohit clears the front foot and thrashes it to the cow corner
holes out to long-on ... It was the slower one and as you would expect at this stage, Rahul Sharma was going to go after every thing  but doesn't connect well..
moves outside leg stump and slices the full delivery to deep point region
Slam! The attempted yorker turns into a full-pitched delivery and the batsman clears the front foot and lifts it over long-on
drops it on the blockhole, dug out back to the bowler
full pitched around off, dragged to right of long-on
Vaas is run out now, though. It was pushed towards cover and Vaas goes for the single but Dogra fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Gone!
run out of Rohit missed yorker around off, dug out towards short mid-off . Rohit is out of the crease .. Tait has the ball but he misses the stumps at the non-striker's end
full pitched outside off, sliced away to third man
Tait tries a slower one but sprays it wide outside off
Wham! Rohit goes down town. It was a full toss and Rohit swing it high over the straight boundary
goes for the yorker, low dipping full toss, pushed out to cover
around 146 full delivery around off, driven to deep cover
on the middle stump line, worked towards long-on
drags it down to deep midwicket for a single
full and on the leg and middle, on driven to long-on
drops it short, pulled to left of deep midwicket where Yusuf mops up
;leans forward to work it to midwicket region for a single
well outside off, swatted away to cover
Dropped by Voges What a clanger! It was pulled straight to deep midwicket where Voges drops a sitter. Absolute mess.
goes for the sweep and doesn't connect
back over the wicket for Rohit who moves down the track but clips it straight to short midwicket
quick, from round the stumps, punched to long-on
leans forward to flick it for a single
spins down the leg side
full around off, driven to long-off
goes back and across to guide the leg break to backward point
tossed up outside off, swept to deep midwicket
spins towards leg, clips the pad and drops on the leg side
slower, turns towards off and mdidle, Rohit eases it, with the turn, to point
on the off and middle line, skidding on a touch, punched to cover
turns in from outside off, worked to wide midwicket region
slightly short in length, shoveled towards long-on
turns in from outside off, pushed back to the bowler
full and outside off, pushed to sweeper cover

Venugopal Rao is run out  Direct hit from Abhishek Jhunjhunwala. It was a mistimed cut shot .. Abhsihek rushed to his right from backward point, picked up the ball, took aim and fired down the stumps at the non-striker's end. Deccan Chargers are in right royal mess here.
drops it short of length, pulled away for a single
stays back to punch this to long-on
length delivery, pushed out to midwicket for a single
fires across a 147 kmph bouncer, Venugopal sways away
another very full delivery that swung in late, pushed out back to Tait
goes for the yorker but sprays it outside leg
The stumps are in disarray. Really full and it swings back in very late, almost at the blockhole, and squeezes through the defenses to crash into the stumps. Clatterrrrrrrrr
banged in short around off and middle, tapped to the off side.. Tait runs across, picks the ball and runs around the batsman and back to his mark
really full delivery around off stump line, driven to deep cover ..
works this one through the on side to retain the strike

Top shot. It's short in length just outside off stump and Rohit plays a skillful on-the-up peachy drive through extra cover. Fazal throws in a desperate dive near the boundary but the ball escapes his effort
Rohit, though, picks the slower one very early this time, waits before swinging it over midwicket boundary
another slower one, around 105 kmph!, that;s really slow, pushed uppishly past the lunging bowler
on the middle stump line, turned to long-leg
taps the slower one to extra cover for a single
moves down the track and on drives to long-on
stretches forward to defend the leg break back down the pitch
lunges out to lift a dipping loopy flighted delivery over extra cover ..
backs away to cut to deep cover
skips down the track to off drive to long-off
stays back to punch it to short extra cover
drives again to long-on for yet another single
stays back to punch it to long-on
leans forward to ping long-on
quick and flat now, on the leg and middle, tapped past square-leg
gets down the track and goes for a lofted on drive but edges it past square-leg
full and down the leg side ..
quick and flat, pushed through the on side

They are in some mood to get run out. It was tapped to the on side .. say towards short-leg and for some reason Suman thinks there is a run in it. The keeper rushes after the ball and Suman gets back in time
full delivery around the leg stump line and Suman is hit on the pad, trying to defend on the front foot. Warne shouts out an appeal .. Dharmasena nods his head.
lovely ripping leg break. It turned in from middle stump and spun right past the defensive poke..
worked to midwicekt
leans forward to defend to the on side

Symonds is run out What a mess. Rohit had on driven the low full toss to right of long-on.. Jhunjhunwala's throw comes in and Symonds is not even in the frame. What  a bad piece of judgement. Symonds turned blindly for the second run and then he suddenly stopped .. and that put him in further trouble
What a ugly swipe.. It was the slow bouncer around off and Rohit swipes it in the air but it falls safely in short mid-on region
short in length and outside off, cutting away, Rohit tries to punch on the up but mistimes it back to the bowler
another slower one, around off stump line, Symonds waits, opens his bat-face to play a little late cut .. again third man was up but he managed to run back to pull the ball back in time
off cutter, on the middle, clipped to deep midwicket
slightly slower, short in length and well outside off stump, Rohit reaches out, opens the bat-face to get it clear of third man, standing up inside the circle
on the off and middle, worked to short midwicket region for a quick single
flighted on a length around leg and middle line, turned towards deep midwicket and there is a misunderstanding. Symonds wants second, Rohit doesn't and Symonds just about manages to retrace his steps
drags this short, flat and quick, outside off, Rohit pulls it to long-on

Gibbs knows this sinking feeling of being fooled by Warney! Deja-vu all over again. Lovely loopy flighted delivery to get his man stumped. It went above the eye line, Gibbs stretched forward to off drive, his back foot came outside the crease but here is where the fun begins. The ball dips rapidly on Gibbs and also turns away from the bat. The keeper takes the bails off ..with the back foot on the line.  it was refereed upstairs .. and the verdict is OUT!
on the middle and leg line, quicker and flatter, tapped to square-leg
lands full in length outside leg stump, flicked through midwicket
slow in the air, turns from outside leg to hit the pad
turns to mid-on for a single
Leans forward to play a classy on-the-up drive through covers. It wasn't short and it wasn't full but it has still disappeared
works this to backward point
straighter and fuller and Symonds defends on the front foot
crashed to point boundary. Short and outside off, Symonds cuts it past the diving Abhishek Jhunjhunwala at point. It traveled at some speed and Abhishek couldn't cover it in time
slightly short in length and Symonds plays a short-arm jab pull to backward square-leg boundary. Very neatly done.
banged in short of length, Symonds tucks it towards  square-leg
banged in short outside off, left alone
banged in short and it flies past the rib cage .. shout for a catch down the leg side as Symonds shapes to leg glance ..
around 146 kmph, banged in short outside off, Laxman goes for another big hit and miscues the attempted pull to mid-on.
tries to swat the short-of-length delivery to the on side and collects a leg bye
full and homing in on the off stump, driven right past the bowler. It races away to the straight boundary
stays back to work this to mid-on for a single
wrists the length delivery from outside off to the on side for a single
That's a slog by any definition. Laxman picked it from outside off stump and swiped it over midwicket. Hmmm...
Another mistimed hit Gibbs moves down the track, Sidharth slips in a slower one and Gibbs rolls his wrist and manages to get it just wide of mid-on
just over mid-on Gibbs takes the risk and tries to hit the length delivery on the up over mid-on.. he mistimed it but managed to get enough wood on it
stays back to cut it down to third man
length delivery outside off, around 128 kmph, mistimed to cover
short in length outside off, punched to point
slower one around off and middle stump line, defended to the on side
short in length, cuts in, there is some grass there and its offering some movement, laxman wants to swing it across the line and is hit high on the pad
gets this down to deep backward square-leg region
cuts in from outside off, Gibbs edges the off drive to fine-leg region.
full in length and outside off, around 125 kmph, sliced away to wide third man
rushes down the track and plays another gorgeous lofted hit. This time to the straight boundary. He makes it look really easy.
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
another wide down the leg side
Gibbs moves down the track and plays a nice lofted hit over long-off.
on the middle stump line, worked to midwicket
quickish, around off and middle line, Laxman is on the back foot, wants to flick but gets a leading edge past point
leans forward to push the length delivery through mid-on
starts with a wide down the leg side. Warne is making his moves here. First Narhwal and now Abhishek
shout for lbw as Laxman misses a flick shot. It would have missed leg stump, though.
outside the off stump, jabbed away
Narwal is absolutely delighted. He is hopping around in joy! GIlchrist went for the big hit over mid-on but miscued it to cover! Huge wicket
stands just outside the crease and goes for the big hit over mid-on but mistimes it along the ground to mid-on
length delivery outside off stump, Laxman times it sweetly to third man
length delivery on the middle and leg line, Gilchrist taps it gently towards midwicket for a single

Good night and good luck Deccan! Yusuf reaches forward to smash it over the straight boundary. Rajasthan Royals complete a thumping win. It was immense fun watching Yusuf bat tonight. Of course no fast bowler with the capability to bowl short deliveries and Yusuf ran amok in a thrillingly entertaining fashion
looks to come out, is beaten in flight but jabs it to the off side
leans forward to defend
Ripper! Yusuf is indulging himself out there. He rocks back to biff a short of length delivery over wide long-on
gets forward to swing this one to deep midwicket
goes for the big hit but miscues it and it lands safely in the unmanned mid-on region
backs away to glide the length delivery to third man
leans forward to defend the off cutter
pushes this towards cover
full in length, tapped to the on side of the pitch
swats it away to deep backward square-leg region
stays back to force it to Rohit at short extra cover
around off stump, steered to backward point
goes for another big hit over the on side but doesn't connect this time
Murderous Wallop! Flighted around leg stump line, from over the wicket, and Yusuf has swung it high over cowcorner. The white ball sails into the night sky. Bye bye!
stays back to punch it to long-on
sprays it wide down the leg side
50 up for the explosive Yusuf. Another full toss from Vaas and Yusuf flays it over long-off. Boom!
leans forward to steer it to point
short in length around off stump line, pushed down to the straight boundary
leans forward to on drive it through mid-on
full in length, hit past the bowler and Symonds makes a super diving stop near the straight boundary. Fab stuff from Andrew
Low full toss around off stump and Yusuf kills it over long-on. Full brutal swing of the bat
lands outside leg , moves in to hit the pad
just outside leg stump line and FAiz plays a nice short-arm lap shot to backward square-leg boundary
length delivery around off, defended to cover
around the off stump line , steered to backward point
Lumb is run out . It was pulled to left of  deep midwicket .. hesitation over the second run .. yes no from Yusuf but Lumb had moved too far down the track before he was sent back .. too late ..
around the off stump line, pushed to extra cover
length delivery angling away from Yusuf who punches it to sweeper cover
shuffles across and fetches the ball from outside off and drags it to long-on
slower one, low full toss, driven to long-on. Lumb want's second but Yusuf says no .. Symonds with the flat throw
really full delivery outside off, Yusuf tries to dig it out, misses and Gilchrist, standing up to the stumps, collects and breaks the stumps
leans forward to drive for a single
pushed to cover.. overthrows as the throw misses the stumps at the non-striker;s end
quicker, turning into middle stump, guided to backward point
from round the stumps now, and flights it full on the leg stump line. Yusuf wants to whip it through midwicket but gets a leading edge towards long-off
Bosh! Yusuf lunges forward, fetches the leg break from outside off and hammers it over wide long-on boundary. Thunderous wallop!
goes down on his knee to slog sweep it to deep midwicket
Rahul lands it on the middle and leg, Lumb paddles it to fine-leg region
moves back to work the ball to midwicket and the bowler rushes off to pick the ball . vacant spaces in the on-side ring
slightly short, pulled away to deep square-leg region
He leans forward to whip a length delivery to midwicket boundary! That was nicely done.. he stretched out and got to the pitch of the ball
big swing and a miss. It spun away from outside off, Yusuf tried to crash it over long-off but makes no contact
Bang! Yusuf stretches forward to muscle a delivery turning away from the middle and off line over long-on
slows up the pace, lands it on the leg and middle, Yusuf stretches across to sweep it very fine. Neatly done
around the off stump line, Yusuf pushes this one back to Ojha
quicker,a leg break this time, Lumb defends towards cover
around the off stump line, again spinning away, a tentative Lumb pokes it to cover ..
turns away from Yusuf who cuts to deep-point region
around the off stump line, it breaks the other way, away from the lefty Lumb who pings deep point
slip and silly-point in. Yusuf stays back to punch it with the turn to deep cover
turns in from outside off, pushed towards long-off
slower, turns in from outside off, punched away to deep cover
rips it quick but slips it down the leg side
stretches forward to jab it to midwicket
Wallop! Slip and silly-point watch the white ball soar into the orbit over long-off.
pushes it wide outside off, Yusuf almost charged at it but decided to let it go to Gilly.
Stumped! Ojha, who has been really good in the IPL games, tosses it up and gets it to dip and spins it  away past the attempted lofted hit ..
leans forward to push to cover
sweeps it from around off stump line for a single
down the leg side, and it catches a bit of the pad
on the middle stump line, swept to square-leg
works it to left of midwicket where Symonds makes a tumbling stop
quicker, on the off stump line, stabbed to short third man region ..
short in length and outside off, cut away to point. Two bad balls but he has escaped
drops it short, pulled away to deep backward square-leg region
Loverly bat speed there. He backed away to cut it to the point boundary. It was flashed away
pushed out to midwicket and they scramble across for a quick single .. Ojha does really well to rush across and dive to get back inside the crease
on the leg stump line, turned past square-leg
That has been flayed! Rohit tosses it up and Ojha hammers it to the straight boundary.
turns from middle and leg, jabbed away
from round the stumps, on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
full pitched and though Lumb fails to connect with his swing to the on side, it dashes off to the fine-leg boundary for four leg byes. What an over for Rajasthan. Much fun was had.
cuts in on the off stump line, pushed out to cover
Whack! This is getting all too easy. Imperious Lumb. He takes a couple of steps down the track and thrashes gentle seam-up delivery to the wide midwicket boundary
RP is being taken to the cleaners. Lumb walks back down the track and crashes it over extra cover. RP can be pretty expensive on Indian tracks
drops it short and Lumb pulls it away to the boundary. Easy pickings.
moves down the track and crashes the overpitched delivery outside off to the point boundary with a firm square drive
from round the stumps, around off stump, mishits the cut
leans forward to quietly push this to extra cover
slows up the pace this time, tosses it around off and middle. Lumb goes for the slog sweep but misses and the ball brushes his thigh en route to Gilchrist
on the middle and leg line again, worked past square-leg
again outside leg, worked to deep square-leg
stays back to clip the off break past square-leg
dropped was it by GIbbs? short and wide, cut away hard .. Gibbs dives but can't hold on to the tough chance.at backward point . will confirm post replays
back of length and outside off stump, edges the off drive through the slips
short in length, on the middle and leg, pushed to the on side for a quick single . Symonds has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses
leans forward to push it to the off-side of the pitch
length delivery moving across the batsman who is beaten, pushing inside the line
walks right outside the sticks, ends up outside off, and whips the full outswinger through midwicket!
shuffles right across and whips the incoming delivery through midwicket
edged but it doesn't carry to Laxman at first slip. Lovely shape away on that delivery from Vaasy, Lumb edges the off derive and Laxman crouches to catch but it dips just short his palms
the slow off cutter .. cuts back into the lefty Lumb who stabs it to his pad
walks down the track, goes for the big off drive but is beaten
length delivery just outside off stump, pushed back down the track
